get.description: The run shown (R11): of business_date, its default run, otherwise its latest intraday run; without business_date, the newest such run (today's intraday run when there is one)

The run's funding (B1): by book (with the write-off) and entity, its lines and problems; state
``not_configured`` when the adapter gave no funding rules, ``not_computed`` for a run before B1.

The run's OCP (B2, TDM#59): derived from positions by component (cash and to be settled, PV of the FX
legs, futures, bonds, their funding liability, other, OCP transfers), reconciled per currency with the
reported ``ocp`` at the report's level, the breaks with their explanation and the transfers per book; state
``no_report`` without a report in force, ``not_computed`` for a run before B2.

Derivatives computed by core from their terms next to the report's PV, per position, book and product
(``publish.derivatives_parallel``); state ``not_computed`` for a run before the block.

parameters.name: ofz_view

schema.description: how the OFZ risk is shown, as the monitors' switch (TDM#173, TDM#213): kbd: «КБД»: an OFZ's rate risk on its own curve, the KBD's par yields (RUB OFZ in dv01_by_curve_rub), RUONIA without it; no OFZ basis (ofz_basis_rub 0): every DV01 and spread field adds up once. An OFZ-PK has no KBD risk: its basis (its spread to RUONIA) is in ofz_spread_kbd_rub. A run before 0.2.6 had its OFZ on RUONIA: their KBD risk is approximated by their basis to RUONIA (ofz_view_note); basis: «RUONIA + базис» (the monitors' default): an OFZ's risk to RUONIA OIS quotes with the basis held (in dv01_by_curve_rub['RUB RUONIA']) and its risk to the OFZ basis, the KBD's par yields with RUONIA held (ofz_basis_rub): two computed risks to two factors (0.2.7, core 0.39), like DV01 and CS01. Their sum is no rate DV01 (it moves the KBD twice): never add ofz_basis_rub to the DV01 fields. The DV01 here is the OFZ's RUONIA risk, a few tenths of a percent off its KBD risk in «КБД». A run of 0.2.6 (and an OFZ off core) has its KBD risk on RUONIA and again as the basis (ofz_view_note). Default 'basis', the monitors' view (TDM#205)
schema.title: Ofz View

Their sum is no rate DV01 (it moves the KBD twice): never add ofz_basis_rub to the DV01 fields. The DV01 here is the OFZ's RUONIA risk, a few tenths of a percent off its KBD risk in «КБД». (``fxRate``, held to the horizon); the funding the lines' own interest when they are in that currency.

keyRatePath.title: Keyratepath

fundingBookLevel.title: Fundingbooklevel
fundingBookLevel.description: Funding lines without a position (cash balances)

provisional.title: Provisional
provisional.description: Funding policy fields at the engine's provisional default

CarryOut.title: CarryOut
CarryOut.description:
The forward carry of a run to a horizon (TDM#66, ``scenario.carry``): «Кэрри» (coupon, pull, roll-down) and
«Фондирование» apart, «Нетто» their sum (TDM#168), per position and by book, entity, currency and kind.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Instrument kind of the risk table (``concepts.instr_kind``)

carry.title: Carry
carry.description: The whole change of value to the horizon (coupons received + the change of the dirty price, the curves carried): coupon + pull + rolldown (core horizon_pnl_rub) + spreadRoll; the screen's one «Кэрри» column

coupon.title: Coupon
coupon.description: Coupons received + the change of the accrued coupon to the horizon

pull.title: Pull
pull.description: The rest of core's carry_rub: the clean price's drift on today's forwards at the held spread (the pull to par)

rolldown.title: Rolldown
rolldown.description: Core's rolldown_rub: the curve keeping its shape

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: Funding over (run date, horizon], RUB (negative: a cost); 0 when the position is not funded on its MV, null when unknown or not configured

net.title: Net
net.description: carry + funding; null while either is

dv01.title: Dv01
dv01.description: The run row's DV01, RUB per bp (as the monitor shows it); null for a position the run did not value

cs01.title: Cs01
cs01.description: The run row's spread risk, RUB per bp: its CS01 (credit), else its OFZ spread risk (ofz_spr01); for a floater the spread is its DM's

fxRate.title: Fxrate
fxRate.description: RUB per unit of ccy the run used (its mv_rub / mv; 1 for RUB), held to the horizon: inCcy = the RUB amounts / fxRate

inCcy.description: carry, coupon, pull, rolldown, spreadRoll, funding, net in the position's currency (ccy), beside the RUB fields

fundingSource.title: Fundingsource
fundingSource.description: The rule that priced the funding (the line's rule_source, TDM#237): adapter, settings, settings_override, default (the settings' market default rate), contract (an HTM lot's own rate); none without a line

spreadRoll.title: Spreadroll
spreadRoll.description: spread=curve: CS01 x spreadRollBp (first order), included in carry; null when the spread is held (spreadCurve says why) or spread=held

spreadRollBp.title: Spreadrollbp
spreadRollBp.description: The spread's roll along its peers' curve to the horizon, bp: curve(tenor at the horizon) - curve(tenor now)

spreadCurve.title: Spreadcurve
spreadCurve.description: spread=curve: the rating grade whose peer curve it rolled on («A (для A+)»: a neighbouring grade's), or why the spread is held: no_rating, no_peer_curve, ofz_held, floater_held, not_rub, redeemed, no_cs01, no_quote, not_covered

carryMethod.title: Carrymethod

code.title: Code

CarryPosition.title: CarryPosition
CarryPosition.description:
One position's carry to the horizon, RUB, signed (``inCcy``: in its currency).
``carry = coupon + pull + rolldown`` (core ``horizon_portfolio``, the curves carried), ``+ spreadRoll`` with
spread=curve; null with ``code`` when there is no forecast.

carry.title: Carry
carry.description: Sum over the covered positions (coupon + pull + rolldown + spreadRoll)

dv01.title: Dv01
dv01.description: Sum of the positions' DV01 (every position that has one)

cs01.title: Cs01
cs01.description: Sum of the positions' cs01 (every position that has one)

funding.title: Funding
funding.description: Funding of the covered positions (those with a carry forecast)

fundingNoCarry.title: Fundingnocarry
fundingNoCarry.description: Funding of the positions without a carry forecast; null when one of them has an unknown funding (nNoCarryNoFunding)

fundingBookLevel.title: Fundingbooklevel
fundingBookLevel.description: Funding lines without a position (cash balances, an entity's cash): a book, an entity, a currency and the total have them; null while the funding is not computed

fundingTotal.title: Fundingtotal
fundingTotal.description: funding + fundingNoCarry + fundingBookLevel; null while the funding is not computed or fundingNoCarry is null

net.title: Net
net.description: carry + fundingTotal; null (rule B1) while the funding is not computed, nothing is covered, or any position's funding is unknown (nCoveredNoFunding, nNoCarryNoFunding)

netKnown.title: Netknown
netKnown.description: Sum of carry + funding of the positions that have both: the net of what is known when net is null

nCoveredNoFunding.title: Ncoverednofunding

nNoCarryNoFunding.title: Nnocarrynofunding
nNoCarryNoFunding.description: Positions without a carry forecast whose funding is unknown: then fundingNoCarry, fundingTotal and net are null (rule B1 applied strictly)

CarrySums.title: CarrySums
CarrySums.description:
A group's sums, RUB. ``net = carry + funding + fundingNoCarry + fundingBookLevel`` (= ``carry +
fundingTotal``; a null part counts 0) whenever ``net`` is not null.

RiskTable.title: RiskTable
RiskTable.description:
The matrix currency x instrument type (R38): ``ccys`` its rows, ``columns`` the kinds present with their
totals over all currencies; a cell is the ``rows`` entry of level ``kind`` (ccy, kind), a row total the entry
of level ``ccy``, the corner ``total``.

dv01_by_curve_rub.title: Dv01 By Curve Rub
dv01_by_curve_rub.description: DV01 by curve, RUB per bp: the monitors' curve ids; an OFZ's KBD risk on RUB OFZ in the ofz_view 'kbd', its RUONIA risk on RUB RUONIA in 'basis' (since 0.2.7 computed apart from the basis; in 0.2.6 its KBD risk)

dv01_all_curves_rub.title: Dv01 All Curves Rub
dv01_all_curves_rub.description: the sum over curves of different currencies: labelled so

ofz_basis_rub.title: Ofz Basis Rub
ofz_basis_rub.description: the OFZ basis to RUONIA OIS, RUB per bp, in the ofz_view 'basis' only (0 in 'kbd'): since 0.2.7 a fixed OFZ's risk to the KBD's par yields with RUONIA held (its KBD par risk), computed apart from its RUONIA risk in dv01_by_curve_rub['RUB RUONIA'] (TDM#213; in 0.2.6 the same risk again); a second factor, as CS01: never add it to the DV01. ofz_spread_kbd_rub.title: Ofz Spread Kbd Rub
ofz_spread_kbd_rub.description: a fixed OFZ's own spread risk to the KBD (0.2.6), RUB per bp; in the ofz_view 'kbd' also an OFZ-PK's spread to RUONIA (its basis in 'basis'); 0 in a run before 0.2.6

dv01_ofz_in_proxy_rub.title: Dv01 Ofz In Proxy Rub
dv01_ofz_in_proxy_rub.description: of which an OFZ-IN's nominal-rate proxy, RUB per bp (TDM#173): a linker core does not value yet (TDM#38), its duration on the KBD. Already in dv01_by_curve_rub (RUB RUONIA in the ofz_view 'basis', RUB OFZ in 'kbd') and dv01_rub, never in ofz_basis_rub: a memo, not a risk to add

fx_delta_rub.title: Fx Delta Rub

RiskTableColumn.title: RiskTableColumn

RunDerivatives.title: RunDerivatives
RunDerivatives.description:
Derivatives computed by core next to the report's PV, before a product is switched (TDM#49). ``state``
not_computed: a run before this block; sums are per status, money sums over the rows with both values.

is_current.title: Is Current
is_current.description: The run shown for its date (R11): its default run, otherwise its latest complete INTRADAY run (today's book on the latest intraday cut). Only the latest INTRADAY run of a date is kept

label.title: Label

ScenarioDefinition.title: ScenarioDefinition
ScenarioDefinition.description:
The prototype scenario shape. curves: bp per RISK_BUCKETS pillar (11) or one number for all, per
published curve ("RUB RUONIA" the RUB bonds' discount curve, "RUB KEY", "RUB OFZ" a shift of the OFZ yields,
the KBD's par yields (TDM#226: an OFZ in RUONIA + basis moves its basis by RUB OFZ - RUB RUONIA), a currency's
"USD"...), each moving only by its own vector; ofzSpread: OFZ Z-spread to RUONIA, bp; fx: % against RUB (+ = weaker rouble). Returned
normalized: 11-pillar lists, zeros and empty entries left out.

SpreadRules.title: SpreadRules
SpreadRules.description: Credit spread shocks in bp, additive; mult scales the position's own spread (factor > 0).
